title: Enigma
description: Documentary featuring an exploration of transgender identity and legacy through comparing and contrasting the life stories of April Ashley and Amanda Lear.

title: Benetton Formula
description: The history of the Formula 1 team led by Alessandro Benetton, told through the memories of its key members and archive footage.

title: Hijacked: Flight 73
description: Documentary exploring the hijacking of Pan Am Flight 73 in Karachi in 1986, during which an airline employee on the ground risked his life negotiating with the hijackers. Featuring first-hand testimony from passengers, flight crew and negotiators, accompanied by dramatic reconstructions.

title: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
description: Oliver Stone's documentary examining the assassination of US president John F Kennedy, using James DiEugenio's 1992 book Destiny Betrayed: JFK, Cuba and the Garrison Case, and recently declassified US government files to shine a light on what happened in Dallas on November 22, 1963. Narrated by Whoopi Goldberg and Donald Sutherland.

title: Lancaster
description: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

title: Fatboy Slim: Right Here, Right Now
description: Documentary about the Big Beach Boutique II free event held in 2002, when an estimated quarter of a million people turned up to the concert on Brighton beach.

title: Billy Idol Should Be Dead
description: The musician's journey from punk rocker to pop star, featuring interviews with Idol himself, his bandmates, family and fellow artists such as Miley Cyrus and Billie Joe Armstrong.

title: Life of Crime 1984-2020
description: Over three decades, this film tells the story of three friends from New Jersey whose lives have been defined and torn apart by their drug addictions.

title: My Icon: Libby Clegg
description: The Paralympic sprinter talks about her idols.

title: Don't Forget Me: The Disappearance of Amy Fitzpatrick
description: Documentary examining the case of Dublin 15-year-old Amy Fitzpatrick, who left her friend Ashley Rose's house on Spain's Costa del Sol at 10pm on New Year's Day in 2008 to walk home and was never seen again.

title: The Loneliest Whale: The Search for 52
description: Documentary about the search to find a rare whale that calls out at a frequency unrecognised by other whales. This mysterious creature is believed to have lived its life in complete solitude, pointing to a greater awareness of human loneliness than ever before.

title: The Directors
description: An insight into the life and career of an Oscar nominated director, responsible for works such as The Grand Budapest Hotel and Fantastic Mr Fox.

title: Discovering: Sissy Spacek
description: A look at the life and career of the actress, who starred in Badlands, Carrie and In the Bedroom and won an Oscar for her portrayal of Loretta Lynn in Coal Miner's Daughter.

title: Discovering: Alan Rickman
description: A look at the life and career of the English actor, who starred in Die Hard, Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves and Love Actually, as well as the Harry Potter franchise.

title: The Directors
description: A profile of brothers Joel and Ethan Coen, whose films include Miller's Crossing, Fargo, The Big Lebowski , O Brother, Where Art Thou? and No Country for Old Men.

title: On the Line: The Richard Williams Story
description: Featuring newly uncovered interviews spanning the 1980s to now, Richard Williams - the father of tennis stars Venus and Serena - retraces his family's journey from the poverty-stricken streets of Shreveport, Louisiana, to the grass courts of Wimbledon.

title: My Icon: Heather Watson
description: British tennis star Heather Watson discusses the individuals who have inspired her over the course of her life.

title: McLaren
description: Director Roger Donaldson's documentary recounting the story of New Zealander Bruce McLaren, who founded the McLaren motor racing team in 1963. He was a man who showed the world that a man of humble beginnings could take on the elite of motor racing and win.

title: My Icon: Leon Pryce
description: The former Bradford Bulls and St Helens star discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and sporting career.

title: Ferrari: Race to Immortality
description: Formula One documentary chronicling the early years of the Scuderia Ferrari racing team, founded by the legendary Enzo Ferrari.

title: My Icon: Linford Christie
description: The former sprint superstar and Olympic gold medalist discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career.

title: Faye
description: The life and career of actress Faye Dunaway, who talks about her bipolar disorder diagnosis and discusses her reputation for being difficult to work with.

title: My Icon: Rachel Yankey
description: The England football star looks at some of the inspirational figures that have had an impact on her career.

title: Jealous Guy: The Assassination of John Lennon
description: An exploration of the life and career of the Beatles superstar, with a look at the strange parallels between him and his killer Mark David Chapman.

title: My Icon: Denise Lewis
description: The former British heptathlete and Olympic gold medallist speaks about the figures who have been an inspiration over the course of her life.

title: Six Silent Killings: Ireland's Vanishing Triangle
description: Part one of two. A look at the investigations prompted by the disappearances from a small area near Dublin of six women within the space of five years in the 1990s.

title: Six Silent Killings: Ireland's Vanishing Triangle
description: Concluding the look at the investigations into the disappearances of six women within the space of five years from a small area near Dublin in the 1990s.

title: Don't Forget Me: The Disappearance of Amy Fitzpatrick
description: Documentary examining the case of Dublin 15-year-old Amy Fitzpatrick, who left her friend Ashley Rose's house on Spain's Costa del Sol at 10pm on New Year's Day in 2008 to walk home and was never seen again.

title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
description: A look at the nerve agent attack on former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in Salisbury, with contributions from intelligence and counterterrorism officials, journalists and victims. The film uncovers how authorities raced to identify the perpetrators, contain a deadly chemical weapon and respond to one of the most brazen acts of state-sponsored aggression on British soil.

title: Tina
description: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome.
